lede: The Telluride Hospital District board meets Thursday with real decisions on the table — including a possible vote on a Two Site Model for the new facility and action on a Letter of Intent, choices that will shape what kind of medical infrastructure this valley has for decades. Also this week, the Town's newly created Resident Advisory Committee holds its very first meeting, organizing a tenant voice for employee-housing renters. Agendas for most other government meetings haven't been posted yet.

notable.stake: Board may vote on Two Site Model and Letter of Intent shaping the new hospital.
Inaugural tenant body elects leadership and sets scope for housing-policy input.
